reason: At base REGEX_FORMAT matches Y{1,4}, so a lone Y and YYY are matched tokens with no entry in matches(), falling through to the zoneStr offset fallback, producing something like +0000 instead of the literal Y.
At head REGEX_FORMAT only matches YYYY|YY, so a lone Y is never matched and passes through literally, and YYY matches YY (two-digit year) leaving a trailing literal Y.
At base #getDecodedParam already percent-decodes params containing %, so %20 in a path param is returned as a space. The PR is only a refactor of that logic.
The refactor extracts the identical contains-%-then-tryDecode logic into tryDecodeURIComponent; param decoding behaviour is unchanged, so %20 still yields a space.
At base reschedule only issues zincrby to Redis and never updates @score, so the in-memory entry keeps returning the stale pre-reschedule score/at.
Head adds @score = at.to_f after the zincrby, so score and the derived at reflect the new time immediately on the same object.
ContentType parsing of "text/plain; charset=UTF-8" is long-standing ktor-http behaviour, entirely separate from parseRangesSpecifier which the PR touches.
The PR only trims whitespace in Range header list elements; ContentType/charset parsing is untouched and continues to report text/plain with charset=UTF-8.

The PR only changes warning/exception message text in ComposerRepository and cannot affect archiving; Composer ZipArchiver adds real files via ZipArchive::addFile, which stores the file mtime, so extracted files keep the source timestamps rather than the 1980 zip epoch.
Same unrelated logging-only change; zip entries are created from on-disk files whose mtimes are stored each time, so repeated archiving yields the same source-matching timestamps and no 1980 dates.

The diff touches only CredentialCacheKey prefix matching in System.Net; System.Text.Json async deserialization of a List<T> with a nullable reference property is unrelated and is well-supported behaviour at this revision.
CredentialCache path comparison has nothing to do with JsonSerializer; sync and async deserialization of the same valid payload agree, so no JsonException is thrown.

CockroachDB restricts ANY/ALL to a fixed subquery_op list (math_op, LIKE/ILIKE); the inet operator <<= is not in it, so the statement fails to parse. The cursor fix in the diff is unrelated and does not add grammar support.
Same grammar limitation at head: >>= is not an accepted operator before ANY in CockroachDB's parser, and the FETCH FIRST cursor fix touches nothing in the parser.
At base every NO_PROXY entry becomes all://*<hostname>, so ::1 produces all://*::1 which URLPattern/URL parsing rejects, raising an error during client construction.
Head detects IPv6 entries and builds all://[::1], a valid URL pattern, so the client constructs successfully and other hosts still proxy normally.

At base, passing flags=re.DOTALL compiles pat with DOTALL|re.U and resets flags to 0; object_array._str_match then compares flags|re.U against pat.flags and raises ValueError. The compiled-pattern form hits the same strict equality check.

Head only compares the IGNORECASE bit and pre-compiles the pattern when flags carry more than case, so DOTALL is honoured for both the flags= and compiled-pattern forms; this is exactly the added test_match_non_ignorecase_flags_applied case.

A chain with groups in the middle hits the prepare_steps chord-upgrade path where prev_task/prev_res are not reset at base, producing duplicated/recursive result parents so the round-tripped tree loses one groups children.
Head resets prev_task/prev_res after a group is upgraded to a chord, so each middle group keeps its own GroupResult and all four children survive the as_tuple/result_from_tuple round trip.

The second positional described is clap raw()/last() style, which needs -- to enter trailing-values mode. At base -- takes the escape branch, sets trailing_values and jumps the positional counter to the last arg, so value1/value2 stay in the first positional and --check lands in the second.

Head suppresses trailing-values mode whenever the current positional has a matching value_terminator, so -- is consumed as the terminator and never starts trailing values; a last()/raw() second positional then rejects --check as an unexpected argument.

At base the OSC11 handler calls nvim_set_option_value(background,...) with autocommands enabled; the PR itself states that a post-VimEnter response triggers OptionSet, and changing background reloads highlights and fires ColorScheme.

Head wraps the assignment in :noautocmd, which suppresses all autocommands for that command - deliberately OptionSet, and as a side effect ColorScheme - so neither autocommand fires even though background updates.
validate_required on a cast changeset that omits the field yields an invalid changeset with a cant-be-blank error; the PR only reorders a compile-time @derive attribute read in Ecto.Schema.
The reordering of the redacted-fields/@derive check is compile-time only and semantically equivalent, so changeset required-field validation is unaffected.
